data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ibn' meaning 'son of'. Ebi is a unisex name in the Islamic tradition and can mean 'fish' in some contexts. The name Ebi carries the meaning “Fish” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Ebi usually hope their child will grow to embody fish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance, renewal, and the sustenance of life.
data.etymology: Ebi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fish.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ebi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إبي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الأب أو الرجل الكبير
in_arabic.long_meaning: إبي هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'أبى' التي تعني الأب أو الرجل الكبير. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة والشجاعة، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالخصال الحميدة مثل الحكمة والرزانة. في الثقافة العربية، يُعطى هذا الاسم للأبناء تعبيرًا عن الرغبة في أن يكونوا مثل آبائهم في الحكمة والشجاعة.

in_urdu.name: ایبی
in_urdu.meaning: ایک مذکر نام جس کا مطلب ہے اب یا بڑا آدمی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایبی ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے اب یا بڑا آدمی۔ یہ نام ان خصال کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد کو قابل احترام بناتے ہیں، جیسے کہ حکمت، شجاعت، اور قیادت کی صلاحیت۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں، یہ نام احترام اور فخر کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب کسی والد یا بزرگ شخصیت کی یاد تازہ کی جائے۔

in_hindi.name: एबी
in_hindi.meaning: एक पुल्लिंग नाम जिसका अर्थ है पिता या बड़ा आदमी
in_hindi.long_meaning: एबी एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है पिता या बड़ा आदमी। यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो एक व्यक्ति को सम्मानित बनाते हैं, जैसे कि बुद्धिमत्ता, वीरता और नेतृत्व क्षमता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम सम्मान और गर्व के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है, खासकर जब किसी पिता या बुजुर्ग व्यक्ति की याद ताज़ा की जाती है।

in_english.name: Ebi
in_english.meaning: A masculine name meaning father or a mature man
in_english.long_meaning: Ebi is a masculine given name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies 'father' or 'a mature man,' embodying qualities of wisdom, courage, and leadership. Historically, the name has been used in various Islamic cultures to denote respect and admiration for paternal figures or elderly men. The etymology of Ebi can be traced back to the Arabic word 'abi,' which directly translates to 'my father' or 'fatherly figure.' In Islamic tradition, names like Ebi are chosen for their positive connotations and spiritual significance, reflecting the values of family, respect, and community.

He was also known as "Ebi-Qulandar", which refers to his being the 'son of the heavens'. This title not only emphasizes his divine ordainment to lead the Muslim community but also connects him to the Sufi tradition of spiritual masters.

historical_references.reference: Ebi Ibn Mubarak, a 9th-century scholar and ascetic of Islamic Jurisprudence and Hadith. He was born in Kufa, Iraq, and died in Damascus, Syria. He was a student of Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal and is known for his extensive collection of Hadith.

Ebi Ibn Sa'id Al-Harrani, a 13th-century Sufi scholar and poet from Harran, present-day Turkey. He was a preeminent figure in the Rumi tradition and is known for his poetry, particularly his masterpiece 'The Conference of the Birds'.
